transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It’s like… the old me, Ruben, the guy who could talk to anybody and get through the day enjoying things, just feels gone.
How long have you been feeling this way, Ruben?

About eight months now. It really started after the new regional manager came in and started leaning on me hard… taking away accounts I’d worked with for years. Since then it’s just been there most days.
Ruben, do you still find pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?

No, not really. I used to look forward to bowling, working in the garden, taking my wife to gallery shows, going dancing… but now I just don’t feel it. I’ll sit there and make excuses, because none of it feels worth the effort anymore.
Have you ever thought about ending your life during these eight months?

Yeah… I have. I don’t have some clear plan, but I’ve had thoughts like maybe my wife and kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And honestly, that scares me. I don’t trust myself with those thoughts the way I used to.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or how you move throughout the day?
I don’t really know how to answer that. I mean… I’ve felt worn down, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether I’m moving slower or anything like that.
Have you been having trouble sleeping since you started feeling this way?

Yes. Nights are bad. I lie there going over work stuff in my head, just staring at the ceiling. And if I do fall asleep, I’m usually up around three or four in the morning… already tired, already dreading the day.
Have you noticed any change in your weight since you started feeling this way?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been weighing myself or paying much attention to it. My clothes don’t feel all that different, I guess.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things that have happened?
Yes. I do. I keep blaming myself… telling myself I’m useless now. Like all those years of taking care of clients and providing for my family don’t count anymore, because I can’t even handle this job.
Do you feel like you're moving slower or faster than you used to, or is it about the same?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed moving faster or slower. I guess I feel worn down, but I don’t know if I’m actually moving differently.
Have you experienced any strange thoughts or heard voices that others couldn't hear since you started feeling this way?
No, I haven’t heard voices or had strange thoughts like that. At least, nothing I’d describe that way.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I feel bad most of the time, but I haven’t really thought of it as being anxious or on edge.
Do you feel like you're resting or sitting still more often than you used to?
I’m not sure. I probably sit around more, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s more than before.
Do you feel like you're resting or sitting still more often than you used to?
I’m still not really sure. I know I spend more time just sitting and not doing much, but I haven’t kept track of whether it’s actually more than I used to.
Do you feel like you're moving slower physically than you used to?
I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed myself moving slower exactly. I just know I’m not doing much, but I can’t say if my body’s actually slower.
Do you feel like your body is moving more slowly than it used to?
I can’t really tell. I haven’t noticed my body moving slower exactly. I’m just not doing a lot, so it’s hard for me to say.
Do you feel like these feelings of heaviness and hopelessness are interfering with your ability to work or take care of things at home?

Yes. It’s gotten in the way pretty badly. I missed an important client presentation at work, and at home I’ve pulled back so much that my wife felt like she had to bring me in. She said I wasn’t safe just carrying on like this.
Do you feel like these feelings have been consistent over the past eight months or have they been getting worse?

It’s been pretty consistent, but I’d say it got worse as time went on. This has been going on about eight months now, since the new regional manager started coming down on me and taking away accounts I’d handled for years.
Would you say these feelings of heaviness and hopelessness have been getting worse over the past few months?
Yes… most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It feels like the old Ruben, the guy who could talk to anybody and actually enjoy the day, is just gone.
Would you say that over the past two weeks, these feelings of heaviness and hopelessness have been among the worst you've experienced since they started?

Yes… I’d say these last couple weeks have been right up there with the worst. Most mornings I wake up with that heavy, hollow feeling in my chest, and it’s like the part of me that used to talk to people and enjoy the day just isn’t there.
Would you say these feelings of heaviness and hopelessness have been present nearly every day over the past two weeks?
Yes. Pretty much every day these past two weeks. I wake up with that heavy, hollow feeling, like the old me who could talk to people and enjoy the day is just… gone.
